contracts.id: DJ Table: Left Deck->DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
contracts.payload: { peaks: number[] /* waveform amplitudes 0-1, one per sample */; beatgrid: number[] /* beat marker positions 0-1 of track */; cues: { id: string; position: number /* 0-1 of track */; label?: string }[]; playhead: number /* 0-1 of track */; bpm: number /* effective BPM incl. pitch */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Left Deck->DJ Table: Central Mixer
contracts.payload: { level: number /* live output signal 0-1 */; peak: number /* recent peak level 0-1 */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Left Deck->DJ Table: Right Deck
contracts.payload: { isMaster: boolean /* true when this deck's Tempo Sync is engaged as master */; bpm: number /* effective BPM incl. pitch */; phase: number /* 0-1 position within current beat */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Right Deck->DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
contracts.payload: { peaks: number[] /* waveform amplitudes 0-1, one per sample */; beatgrid: number[] /* beat marker positions 0-1 of track */; cues: { id: string; position: number /* 0-1 of track */; label?: string }[]; playhead: number /* 0-1 of track */; bpm: number /* effective BPM incl. pitch */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Right Deck->DJ Table: Central Mixer
contracts.payload: { level: number /* live output signal 0-1 */; peak: number /* recent peak level 0-1 */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Right Deck->DJ Table: Left Deck
contracts.payload: { isMaster: boolean /* true when this deck's Tempo Sync is engaged as master */; bpm: number /* effective BPM incl. pitch */; phase: number /* 0-1 position within current beat */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Central Mixer->DJ Table: Left Deck
contracts.payload: { fader: number /* channel volume 0-100 */; gain: number /* trim in dB, -12 to 12 */; eq: { hi: number /* dB, -24 to 12 */; mid: number /* dB, -24 to 12 */; low: number /* dB, -24 to 12 */ }; crossfader: number /* -100 (full A) to 100 (full B) */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Central Mixer->DJ Table: Right Deck
contracts.payload: { fader: number /* channel volume 0-100 */; gain: number /* trim in dB, -12 to 12 */; eq: { hi: number /* dB, -24 to 12 */; mid: number /* dB, -24 to 12 */; low: number /* dB, -24 to 12 */ }; crossfader: number /* -100 (full A) to 100 (full B) */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display->DJ Table: Left Deck
contracts.payload: { position: number /* target seek position, 0-1 of track */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display->DJ Table: Right Deck
contracts.payload: { position: number /* target seek position, 0-1 of track */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Effects Rack->DJ Table: Left Deck
contracts.payload: { units: { id: number; type: 'echo' | 'reverb' | 'filter' | 'flanger'; wet: number /* dry/wet 0-100 */; div: '1/16' | '1/8' | '1/4' | '1/2' | '1' | '2' | '4' /* beat division */ }[] /* only units assigned to channel A and toggled on */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Effects Rack->DJ Table: Right Deck
contracts.payload: { units: { id: number; type: 'echo' | 'reverb' | 'filter' | 'flanger'; wet: number /* dry/wet 0-100 */; div: '1/16' | '1/8' | '1/4' | '1/2' | '1' | '2' | '4' /* beat division */ }[] /* only units assigned to channel B and toggled on */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Track Library Browser->DJ Table: Left Deck
contracts.payload: { id: string; title: string; artist: string; key: string /* Camelot key, e.g. '8A' */; duration: string /* mm:ss */; bpm: number /* analyzed BPM */ }

contracts.id: DJ Table: Track Library Browser->DJ Table: Right Deck
contracts.payload: { id: string; title: string; artist: string; key: string /* Camelot key, e.g. '8A' */; duration: string /* mm:ss */; bpm: number /* analyzed BPM */ }

channelList.id: DJ Table: Left Deck->DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
channelList.description: Streams this deck's loaded track waveform data, beatgrid, cue-point markers and live playhead position to the top waveform lane so it renders and animates in real time.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Left Deck->DJ Table: Central Mixer
channelList.description: Feeds channel A its live audio level so the mixer's channel-A VU meter reflects this deck's output signal.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Left Deck->DJ Table: Right Deck
channelList.description: When this deck's Tempo Sync is engaged as master, it emits its BPM and beat phase for Deck B to lock onto.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Right Deck->DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display
channelList.description: Streams this deck's loaded track waveform data, beatgrid, cue-point markers and live playhead position to the bottom waveform lane so it renders and animates in real time.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Right Deck->DJ Table: Central Mixer
channelList.description: Feeds channel B its live audio level so the mixer's channel-B VU meter reflects this deck's output signal.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Right Deck->DJ Table: Left Deck
channelList.description: When this deck's Tempo Sync is engaged as master, it emits its BPM and beat phase for Deck A to lock onto.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Central Mixer->DJ Table: Left Deck
channelList.description: The channel-A fader, gain knob, 3-band EQ and crossfader position emit the volume/EQ/balance settings that scale and tone-shape Deck A's output into the master mix.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Central Mixer->DJ Table: Right Deck
channelList.description: The channel-B fader, gain knob, 3-band EQ and crossfader position emit the volume/EQ/balance settings that scale and tone-shape Deck B's output into the master mix.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display->DJ Table: Left Deck
channelList.description: When the user clicks or drags on the top lane, emits the target seek position so Deck A jumps its playhead to that point.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Dual Waveform Display->DJ Table: Right Deck
channelList.description: When the user clicks or drags on the bottom lane, emits the target seek position so Deck B jumps its playhead to that point.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Effects Rack->DJ Table: Left Deck
channelList.description: When an FX unit's channel-assign is set to A and toggled on, emits the effect type, dry/wet amount and beat division so the effect is applied to Deck A's audio output.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Effects Rack->DJ Table: Right Deck
channelList.description: When an FX unit's channel-assign is set to B and toggled on, emits the effect type, dry/wet amount and beat division so the effect is applied to Deck B's audio output.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Track Library Browser->DJ Table: Left Deck
channelList.description: When the user selects a track and clicks 'Load to Deck A' (or drags it there), emits the track's audio file, metadata (title, artist, key, duration) and analyzed BPM so Deck A loads it and resets its playhead.

channelList.id: DJ Table: Track Library Browser->DJ Table: Right Deck
channelList.description: When the user selects a track and clicks 'Load to Deck B' (or drags it there), emits the track's audio file, metadata (title, artist, key, duration) and analyzed BPM so Deck B loads it and resets its playhead.
